## Problem

Describe one concrete problem and the user or maintainer affected.

## Boundary

List the files or component owned by this task and explicit non-goals.

## Acceptance

Provide a deterministic command and expected result. Do not require private
credentials, paid resources, or publishing access.

## Security

Confirm that fixtures and outputs contain no tokens, private URLs, absolute
paths, raw text/token IDs, activations, gradients, or checkpoint tensors.
